test_objective: Verify that on a GET HTTP request if nothing is specified on the Accept header, "application/json" is assumed

test_cases.name: 044_02_01 endpoint /entities/{entityId}
test_cases.doc: Verify that on a GET HTTP request if nothing is specified on the Accept header, "application/json" is assumed (/entities/{entityId})
test_cases.teardown: Delete Entity by Id Returning Response
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${id}' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to '*/*'
}
